---
title: "My Solutions"
---

```{r include=FALSE}
repo_name <- basename(getwd())
current_filename <- xfun::with_ext(knitr::current_input(), "qmd")
pages_base_url <- paste0("https://byuim301.github.io/", repo_name, "/")
issues_url <- paste0("https://github.com/BYUIm301/", repo_name, "/issues")

library(tidyverse)
library(DT)

# Locate all html files, and put them in a table.
my_files <-
  list.files(pattern = "P\\..+html") %>%
  tibble(name = .) %>%
  mutate(Problem = str_extract(name, "(?<=P\\.)[:digit:]+")) %>%
  mutate(Problem = Problem %>% as.numeric()) %>%
  mutate(url = paste0("<a href='", pages_base_url, name, "' target='_blank'>", name, "</a>")) %>%
  arrange(-Problem) %>%
  select(Problem, url)
```

```{r results='asis', echo = FALSE}
cat("-   Link to [GitHub Issues](", issues_url, ")\n")
cat(paste0("-   Last modified: ", Sys.Date()))
```

## Table of Submissions

Here's my solutions in a table. Save files in the form `P.x.qmd` for them to appear sorted in this list.

```{r echo=FALSE}
DT::datatable(my_files,
  escape = FALSE,
  rownames = FALSE,
  options = list(pageLength = 10)
)
```

```{r include=FALSE}
## Save the list above for use in class-wide list.
write_csv(my_files %>% mutate(author = repo_name), "file_list.csv")
```
